title: Early Detection of Nucleation Events From Solution in LC-TEM by Machine Learning
summary: Tracking growth revealed two regimes for small circular precipitates, consistent with a metastable early phase and a two-step pathway in this experiment. The detector was checked against labeled LC-TEM frames and applied to experimental videos. The growth observations do not discriminate between the two proposed changes in phase or growth process.
ai_technology: A YOLOv5 detector identified and tracked early precipitate formation in liquid-cell transmission electron microscopy video.
